label: Sedimentary rocks
text: EA.O.A1.3 Sedimentary rocks. Formed by deposition and lithification. Grain size, sorting and composition are the descriptors. A sedimentary structure (cross-bed, ripple, graded bed) is evidence of the depositing process. Sedimentology is the A1 process claim; the sequence is EA.O.A3.

warrant.standard: Analytical identification (XRD, microprobe) with stated precision
